Bug fixes, correctness improvements, and optimizations
Documentation, examples, technical blog posts, and developer-experience improvements
request.recipient: Intersect Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v for MLabs as vendor via Intersect administration.
request.what: Annual funding for maintenance and enhancement of Plutarch and Ply, including compatibility work, bug fixes, optimizations, documentation, examples, technical blog posts, and developer-experience improvements.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 1,162,746 ada, consisting of 1,128,880 ada for Plutarch and Ply maintenance, compatibility, and developer experience plus a 33,866 ada Intersect budget administration fee.

Plutarch is described as a Haskell eDSL for creating efficient Cardano smart contracts via controlled compilation into UPLC, while Ply serializes Plutarch scripts to and from CIP-57 blueprint-style artifacts with inferred types.
MLabs states that a recent internal audit found at least 26 teams using Plutarch and Ply, while the rationale separately says it conservatively counted at least 15 teams.
MLabs claims Plutarch scripts rank among the smallest in its public cross-language benchmark suite while requiring comparatively low on-chain compute and memory, and provides a benchmark URL.

The proposal says the next funding period may cover Cardano ledger, Plutus, and tooling evolution, including protocol-era compatibility for major ledger updates such as the Dijkstra era if relevant changes land.

The proposal states that it achieved the required 67% support threshold in the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain submission under the approved Budget Process Framework.
The proposal asserts that the requested amount does not, at submission, breach the applicable 350M ada Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713, either alone or in aggregate.

The proposal discloses prior MLabs treasury and ecosystem funding, including prior Plutarch/Ply Catalyst funding, an Intersect Conway-era Plutarch update grant, and three listed governance actions for related MLabs work.

Intersect states that funds will be administered through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with a Treasury Reserve Smart Contract, a Project-Specific Smart Contract, Intersect admin and leadership roles, and six named external oversight entities.
The proposal states that a public dashboard and on-chain records will allow the community to audit and track the withdrawn ada associated with this project.

summary: The document requests 1,162,746 ada for MLabs Plutarch and Ply maintenance through Intersect-administered treasury smart contracts, citing developer tooling value, ecosystem usage, benchmark performance, Intersect budget-process approval, NCL compliance, prior funding disclosures, and oversight mechanisms.
